name: octsel-v1
status: frozen before the second annotator's (FL_NG) counts were delivered or opened (at freeze time no FL_NG count/label file exists in the project; only the planning documents handover/results/PREREG_labelday_FLNG*.md)
what: learned octave selector for the frozen training-free spectral counter (methods/results/counting_frozen_final.py, predictions methods/predictions_ours_150.csv): per file and axis predict k in {-1, 0, +1} from label-free features and output count = counter count * 2^k

per_axis: lr_lattice, lr_fft, lr_profile, lr_tiles, lr_gabor = log2(stage estimate / final count)
g_c, g_2c, g_half = whitened spectral evidence (frozen Spectrum.lookup) at the counted frequency, 2x and 0.5x, along the counter's lattice direction
lr_gpt = log2(GPT-6.1-sol P1 / count), h = gpt-6.1-sol__v, v = gpt-6.1-sol__h
features_label_free.code: methods/octave_learned/octsel_features.py (imports the frozen counter read-only; md5 3d0520d6bec8a016543ce7e5b353d784)

training: target k* = clip(round(log2(FL_SA h_tpi|v_tpi / counter h_count|v_count)), -1, 1) on the 76 scene representatives x 2 axes (k* = -1/0/+1 on 32/64/56 axes); multinomial logistic regression on standardised features, L2 (0.5||W||^2 + C sum w_i CE_i), class-balanced weights; C from {0.001 ... 100} by NESTED grouped CV inside the training folds (criterion class-balanced log-loss; C = 0.03 in every outer fold and for the all-data model); 5 folds = handover/results/labelday_diag_FLSA_20261012/cnn_cv_FLSA/fabric_grouped/folds.csv (each of the 44 fabric groups of paper/tables/fabric_groups_v2.csv in one fold; same folds as the fabric-grouped CNN and ens-v1)

decision_rule.primary: undo class balancing with the training class frequencies (p_j ~ p_bal_j * prior_j), choose k minimising expected APE with COST[k, j] = 100 |2^(k-j) - 1|
decision_rule.secondary: argmax of the class-balanced probabilities (the design as first specified)

out_of_fold: predictions_octsel_oof_FLSA_150.csv: all 150 files, each predicted by the model of its scene's fold (trained without that scene's fabric group); columns id, h_count, v_count, k_h, k_v, fold, prior-corrected probabilities
all_data_model: model_octsel_v1.json (fitted on all 76 FL_SA scenes; for new label-free files: octsel_features.py --ours <counter preds> --gpt <VLM wide preds>, then octsel_v1.py --predict <features.csv> --out <preds.csv>); its predictions on the 150 files: predictions_octsel_full_150.csv (in-sample for FL_SA)
honesty: POST HOC. The features were chosen after FL_SA's counts had been diagnosed (octave errors of the counter; analysis A2's label-free spectral evidence at c, 2c, c/2; GPT agreeing with the counter on halving axes). The model is TRAINED on FL_SA's counts (out of fold by fabric group). The decision rule was changed once after seeing FL_SA out-of-fold results: the design as first specified (class-balanced, argmax) scored 48.3% MAPE (raw counter 41.7%); four decision variants (class-balanced or unweighted x argmax or minimum expected APE) were then compared out of fold on FL_SA and the class-balanced + minimum-expected-APE rule (37.5%) was adopted, so its FL_SA out-of-fold number is optimistically selected. Features, C grid and folds were not changed after any result. A no-training reference computed in the same evaluation, the counter snapped to GPT-6.1-sol's octave, scored 31.3% on FL_SA, i.e. better than octsel-v1. Every FL_SA number is post hoc. FL_NG's counts have never been seen; they are the blind test.

primary_test.reference: FL_NG ALONE (per-scene labels of the second annotator, labels_per_scene format; never seen when this file was written)
primary_test.command: <repo>/.tools/venv/bin/python -I -B methods/octave/eval_octave_v1.py --labels <FL_NG labels_per_scene.csv> --names FL_NG --reference each --pred methods/octave_learned/predictions_octsel_oof_FLSA_150.csv (the --pred method is printed under the label 'octave-v1'; 'ours-frozen' = the raw spectral counter)
primary_test.primary_endpoint: MAPE over the 76 scene representatives (mean of the per-scene mean of |pred-ref|/ref over h and v)
paired_comparisons: octsel-v1 minus the raw spectral counter (ours-frozen)
primary_test.statistics: as printed by eval_octave_v1.py: scene bootstrap 10,000, seed 20261012, 95% percentile CI of dMAPE; Wilcoxon signed-rank; both-axes-within-5% share with exact McNemar
primary_test.decision: octsel-v1 improves on the counter if the dMAPE CI vs ours-frozen lies entirely below 0; it beats GPT-6.1-sol only if the CI vs GPT lies entirely below 0
primary_test.expectation_from_FLSA_cv: vs counter -4.3 [-10.0, +1.3] (not significant); vs GPT +8.7 [+4.0, +13.4] (worse); we do not expect it to beat GPT-6.1-sol or ens-v1

secondary: vs ens-v1: the same command with --frozen methods/ensemble/predictions_ens_v1_150.csv (the 'ours-frozen' slot then holds ens-v1)
the all-data model: --pred methods/octave_learned/predictions_octsel_full_150.csv (trained on FL_SA's counts of the same scenes)
mean of both annotators: --labels <FL_NG> <FL_SA> --names FL_NG FL_SA --reference mean
exploratory (reported, not tuned): geometric means --pred predictions_octsel_geo_gpt_oof_FLSA_150.csv and predictions_octsel_geo_ens_v1_oof_FLSA_150.csv
k accuracy against k* recomputed from FL_NG (same definition)
